2. [RARC.5.4.6] **Activation-creation order — second key, and only
   within one rule.** Among activations of the same rule,
   partial matches completed earlier fire before those
   completed later, by the creation timetag [LDET.5.5] defines — a
   stamp monotone in completion order, assigned when a match completes. It never decides
   between two rules. `[LDET.5.5]` is the normative
   statement.
